items.why: Chip stocks are leading the wipeout, with the Nasdaq plunging 5% amid the chip stock selloff.
Shares in Musk's SpaceX are plunging as tech and AI stocks fall, and the broader tech rout is deepening.
The AI liquidation behind Wall Street's plunge is hitting chip names hardest, with the Nasdaq set to confirm a correction.
The Nasdaq is down about 5% as AI stocks tumble and the tech rout deepens.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 5.35% and S&P futures down 3.76%, while gold is up 1.09% and oil is up 2.87%.
summary: Stocks are plunging, with the Nasdaq down about 5% as chip stocks wipe out and the Dow and S&P 500 erase post-election rally gains.
